Bridge and review-camera positions are read from the live campus source without changing it. Campus bridge uses the approved two-floor gameplay adaptation.
The distant mountain silhouette is a schematic geometry proxy from P019, not a DEM or photograph texture.
Ramp existence and straight descent are user-confirmed. Exterior covered parking reaches the ramp; the independently adapted interior parking still needs alignment before integration.
The road continues beside Povo 2 to its north end. Garage roof and podium are part of the Povo 2 building; the approved surface lot west of Povo 1 stays open.
Front roads, terraces, library/entrance wings and facade details are a photo-guided exterior study, not a measured or collision-validated interior connection.

street_end_gate.interpretation: User-confirmed far side of the street, opposite both main entrances. Long fixed gate/fence separates the campus street from the unplayable area. North of the bridge it follows the registered east kerb, 6 m east of the centreline, and ends before the relocated roundabout carriageway.
